meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: Assists in writing high-quality content by conducting research, adding citations, improving hooks, iterating on outlines, and providing real-time feedback on each section. Transforms your writing process from solo effort to collaborative partnership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过调研、引用和实时反馈提升写作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效完成高质量文章或内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Improve writing quality with research, citations, and real-time feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce high-quality articles or content efficiently

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成你的写作搭档：帮你构思大纲、查找资料、添加引用、改进开头、逐段反馈，同时保留你的个人风格。
howto.when: 当你开始写博客、文章、教程或案例研究，需要大纲、研究或逐段反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这篇文章创建一个大纲。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成大纲。

say.text: 研究一下AI对产品管理的影响，并添加引用。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并添加引用。

say.text: 我刚写完引言，帮我改进一下开头。
say.note: Claude 会分析并提供改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: helps brainstorm outlines, research topics, add citations, improve hooks, give section-by-section feedback, and preserve your voice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start writing blog posts, articles, tutorials, or case studies and need outlining, research, or feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for this article.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through outlining.

say_en.text: Research AI's impact on product management and add citations.
say_en.note: Claude will search and add citations.

say_en.text: I just finished the introduction. Help me improve the hook.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest improvements.
